## `neuro.date.getTime`

Instance method on `Date.prototype`.

> Returns the stored time value in milliseconds since midnight, January 1, 1970 UTC.

## Signatures

```ts
getTime(input: { date: <receiver>; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Date.prototype.getTime` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
